paragraphs.en: It was early morning, cold and piercing—a chill that seemed to penetrate to the bone. The sky was clear and bright, with trees glistening in the sunlight. However, where Silver stood with his lieutenant, it was dark and damp; they were knee-deep in a mist that had risen from the swamp.
paragraphs.zh: 清晨，寒意刺骨，仿佛直透肌骨。天空明净而明亮，阳光下树木闪烁着光泽。然而，在银色和他的副官站立的地方，却是阴暗潮湿的景象；他们陷入了一片从沼泽升起的浓雾中，足踝都被浸湿了。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett warned his men: "Stay indoors, this is likely a trick." He then called out to the approaching buccaneers. "Who goes?
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长警告手下：“待在室内，这恐怕是个圈套。”随后他朝逼近的海盗喊道：“是哪位？”

paragraphs.en: Stand or we fire."
paragraphs.zh: “要么站出来，要么开火。”

paragraphs.en: "Flag of truce," shouted Silver.
paragraphs.zh: “停火旗！”银脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: Smollett, cautious and wary, turned to us and instructed, "Doctor's watch on the lookout. Dr. Livesey take the north side; Jim, the east; Gray, west. All hands load muskets quickly."
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫利特谨慎而警惕地转向我们，吩咐道：“大夫的怀表负责计时。莱维斯 doctor，请你把北面守住；吉姆，负责东面；格雷，西面。所有人迅速装填火枪。”

paragraphs.en: He then addressed the mutineers: "What do you want with your flag of truce?"
paragraphs.zh: 他随后对叛乱者们说道：“你们要这面停战旗做什么？”

paragraphs.en: The other man replied, "Cap'n Silver to come on board and make terms."
paragraphs.zh: 另一个男人回答说：“银狐船长要上船来谈条件。”

paragraphs.en: Smollett was skeptical, shouting back, "Cap'n Silver! I don't know him. Who is he?"
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫利特半信半疑，大声喊道：“银牙船长！我不认识他。他是谁？”

paragraphs.en: He muttered to himself, "Captain? Promotion!"
paragraphs.zh: 他自言自语道：“船长？升职了！”

paragraphs.en: Long John stepped forward and said, "Me, sir. These poor lads have chosen me captain after your desertion." He emphasized the word "desertion" with particular force.
paragraphs.zh: 长腿约翰上前说道：“就是我，先生。这些可怜的小伙子们在你弃船后选我为队长。”他特别强调了“弃船”这个词。

paragraphs.en: "We're willing to submit if we can come to terms. All I ask is your word, Cap'n Smollett, to let me out of this stockade safely and give me one minute before a gun is fired."
paragraphs.zh: “我们愿意接受，只要能达成协议。斯莫莱特船长，我只求您答应安全地放我出去，并且在开枪前给我一分钟时间。”

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett replied sternly, "My man, I have no desire to talk to you. If you wish to speak with me, come forward. Any treachery will be on your side, and the Lord help you."
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长严厉地回答：“喂，伙计，我没兴趣和你说话。如果你想和我说话，就站出来吧。如果你胆敢耍什么花招，可别怪天不助你。”

paragraphs.en: Long John responded cheerfully, "That's enough, cap'n. A word from you is enough. I know a gentleman."
paragraphs.zh: 长腿约翰愉快地回答：“够了，船长。你一句话就够了。我知道你是位绅士。”

paragraphs.en: Silver managed to climb over the stockade despite his crutch and the difficult terrain, showing remarkable skill as he vaulted the fence. He then approached the captain, who was seated on the threshold, whistling "Come, Lasses and Lads" while staring at the bubbling water from an old iron kettle.
paragraphs.zh: Silver凭借拐杖和崎岖的地形艰难地攀过了栅栏，展现了非凡的技巧。他跃过篱笆后，走近坐在门槛上的队长。队长正吹着口哨哼唱着《来吧，姑娘们小伙们》，目光注视着一只旧铁壶里沸腾的水。

paragraphs.en: The captain noticed Silver's efforts and said, "Here you are, my man. You had better sit down."
paragraphs.zh: 船长注意到了赛勒斯·金斯利的努力，说道：“你干得不错，伙计。还是坐下吧。”

paragraphs.en: Long John complained about sitting outside in the cold morning. The captain retorted, "If you'd been honest, you could have sat in your galley. It’s your own doing.
paragraphs.zh: 长腿约翰抱怨着坐在外面的冷早晨，船长反驳道：“如果你当初坦白了，就可以待在你的铺位上。这都是你自己造成的。”

paragraphs.en: Either you were treated as a cook or a mutineer and pirate. Choose wisely."
paragraphs.zh: 要么把你当成厨师对待，要么就视你为叛乱者和海盗。好好想想吧。

paragraphs.en: Silver sat on the sand and said, "You'll need to help me up again, cap'n. This place is cozy enough. Hey Jim! Top of the morning to you.
paragraphs.zh: 银色坐在沙地上说：“船长，你得再帮我一把。这里挺舒服的。嘿，吉姆！早上好。”

paragraphs.en: Doctor, here's my service. Look, we're all together like a happy family."
paragraphs.zh: 医生，这就是我的服务。你看，我们像一家人一样其乐融融。”

paragraphs.en: Silver replied, "Right you are, Cap'n Smollett. Duty is duty, indeed. Your lay last night was good—some of us handled the handspike well.
paragraphs.zh: 银色回答道：“确实如此，斯莫莱特船长。职责就是职责。你昨晚的份额不错——我们中有几个人对那根手撑杆掌握得挺到位。”

paragraphs.en: I admit some of my men were shaken, maybe all, and that's why I'm here on terms. But mark me, cap'n, it won't happen again! We'll have sentry-go and cut back on rum.
paragraphs.zh: 我承认我的手下有些动摇，也许所有人都动摇了，因此我才以这样的条件前来。但请记住，船长，这种情况绝不会再发生！我们会加强警戒，并减少朗姆酒的供应。

paragraphs.en: You think we were all drunk? No, I was sober; just tired. If I'd woken up a bit sooner, I’d have caught you."
paragraphs.zh: 你认为我们全都喝醉了？不，我是清醒的；只是累了。如果我早醒一会儿，就能抓住你们。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett replied calmly, "Well?"
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长平静地回答：“怎么样？”

paragraphs.en: Silver's words puzzled him, but his tone betrayed nothing. I began to suspect Ben Gunn’s last words. He must have visited the pirates while they were drunk and left us with only fourteen enemies.
paragraphs.zh: 赛勒斯的话让他感到困惑，但他语气中却没有任何端倪。这让他开始怀疑本·古恩临终前的那番话。古恩肯定是在海盗们醉酒时悄悄造访过他们，留下我们只有十四名敌人这个消息。

paragraphs.en: Silver continued, "We want that treasure, and we'll get it—that's our goal! You'd save your lives too, right? And here's what you need: your chart."
paragraphs.zh: Silver接着说：“我们想要那份财宝，而且我们会得到它——这是我们唯一的目标！你们也会因此保住性命吧？这里是你所需要的：航海图。”

paragraphs.en: The captain replied, "That may be true."
paragraphs.zh: 船长回答说：“这也许是真的。”

paragraphs.en: "Of course I know you have one," said Long John. "Don't act tough; there’s no use in that. We just want the chart.
paragraphs.zh: “当然我知道你有一个。”长约翰说道，“别装酷了，那也没用。我们只是想要那份图表。”

paragraphs.en: I never meant to harm you."
paragraphs.zh: “我从来无意伤害你。”

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett interrupted, "That won’t do with me. We know your intentions and don’t care now since you can’t carry them out."
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长插话说：“这可不行。我们清楚你的企图，现在你无法实施，所以我们并不在意。”

paragraphs.en: He calmly filled his pipe. Silver interjected, "If Abe Gray—"
paragraphs.zh: 他冷静地填上了烟斗。赛勒斯插话道：“如果艾比·格雷——”

paragraphs.en: "Stop!" cried Mr. Smollett. "Gray told me nothing, and I asked him nothing.
paragraphs.zh: “住手！”斯莫莱特先生喊道，“格雷什么也没告诉我，我也未曾问他。”

paragraphs.en: I’d see both of you and this island blown to pieces before I let that happen. That’s my stance."
paragraphs.zh: 我宁可看到你们俩和这座岛粉身碎骨，也不会让那样的事情发生。这是我坚定的立场。

paragraphs.en: Silver seemed calmer after this outburst. He had been growing irritated but now composed himself.
paragraphs.zh: 银色在这一阵爆发之后似乎平静了下来。他原本越来越烦躁，但现在终于平复了心情。

paragraphs.en: Silver nodded. "Fine," he said. "You can have the chart to find the treasure.
paragraphs.zh: 银色点了点头。“好吧，”他说，“你可以拿着这张寻宝图。”

paragraphs.en: Just don't shoot any sailors or bash their heads in while they sleep."
paragraphs.zh: just别在他们睡觉时射杀水手或者砸碎他们的脑袋。

paragraphs.en: The two men sat silently smoking for a while, occasionally looking at each other or spitting.
paragraphs.zh: 两人沉默地坐着抽烟，偶尔互相看看或者吐个烟圈。

paragraphs.en: "Now," Silver continued, "here's what we'll do. You give us the map and stop killing your crewmates. In return, you can either join us once we've loaded the treasure, and I promise to get you safely ashore on my honor.
paragraphs.zh: “现在，”Silver继续说道，“这是我们的计划。你把地图交出来，停止杀害你的同伴。作为交换，你可以等到我们装载完财宝之后加入我们，并且我保证凭我的荣誉把你安全送上岸。”

paragraphs.en: Or if that doesn't suit you, some of my men are rough and might have old grudges from hazing. You can stay here, and we'll share our supplies equally. I’ll also give you a fair chance by sending a ship to pick you up once we leave."
paragraphs.zh: 或者你不喜欢这样，我的一些手下可能粗野得很，以前因为欺凌别人还结下不少怨恨。你可以留在这里，我们共享物资。我还会给你一个公平的机会，在我们离开后派船来接你。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett stood up and flicked the ashes of his pipe into his left palm.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长站起身来，将烟斗里的灰烬弹进了左手掌心。

paragraphs.en: "Is that all?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: “就这些吗？”他脱口问道。

paragraphs.en: "Every last word," John replied fiercely. "Refuse, and it's over for you."
paragraphs.zh: “每一句话我都不会放过，”约翰怒声道，“如果你拒绝，那就一切都完了。”

paragraphs.en: The captain responded calmly. "Very well. If you come one by one, unarmed, I'll put you in irons and take you back to England for a fair trial.
paragraphs.zh: 船长镇定自若地回答：“好吧。如果你们一个个空手前来，我会将你们戴上手铐，带回英国接受公正的审判。”

paragraphs.en: If not, my name is Alexander Smollett, and I've deserted the king. You're all going to Davy Jones's locker. You can't find the treasure, sail the ship, or fight us—Gray got away from five of you.
paragraphs.zh: 如果不行的话，我叫亚历山大·斯莫莱特，已经弃君主于不顾了。你们全都得去见 Davy Jones 了。你们找不到财宝，也驾驭不了这条船，更别想和我们对抗——格雷一个人就甩开了你们五个人。

paragraphs.en: Your ship is trapped, Silver; you're on a lee shore. These are your last good words from me."
paragraphs.zh: 你的船被困住了，银；你已经处于危险的浅水区。这可能是我最后一次给你好的建议了。

paragraphs.en: Silver's face burned with anger. He shook his pipe out into the fire.
paragraphs.zh: 赛勒斯的脸涨得通红，愤怒不已。他把烟斗里的灰烬弹进了火里。

paragraphs.en: "Give me a hand up!" he shouted.
paragraphs.zh: “快拉我一把！”他喊道。

paragraphs.en: "Not I," replied the captain.
paragraphs.zh: “不是我，”船长回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Who'll give me a hand up?" Silver roared.
paragraphs.zh: “谁来帮我一把？”银色的声音吼道。

paragraphs.en: No one moved. Growling, he crawled to the porch and pulled himself back onto his crutch. Then he spat into the spring.
paragraphs.zh: 没有人动弹。他发出低沉的吼声，爬到门廊上，艰难地重新扶起了拐杖。然后，他朝春雨中吐了口唾沫。

paragraphs.en: "There! That's what I think of you," he cried. "Before an hour is out, I'll destroy your blockhouse like a rum puncheon.
paragraphs.zh: “瞧！这就是我对你的看法，”他喊道，“不出一小时，我就会像打翻朗姆酒桶一样摧毁你的防御工事。”

paragraphs.en: Laugh, by thunder, laugh! Before an hour is out, you'll be laughing on the other side. Those who die will be the lucky ones."
paragraphs.zh: 雷声般好笑！不出一小时，你就会乐在其中。而那些死去的人倒是幸运的。

paragraphs.en: With a terrible oath, Silver stumbled away, ploughed down the sand, and was helped across the stockade after several attempts. He disappeared among the trees in an instant.
paragraphs.zh: 银色脱口而出了一句可怕的咒骂，踉跄着退开，一头栽进沙地。经过几次努力，他才被人扶过了栅栏。转眼间，他就消失在了树林中。
